latestVersion.changelog:
Initial release of AI Wedding Video Editor.

- Automates editing of multi-camera, multi-device wedding footage into professional highlight reels and ceremony videos.
- Features automatic identification of key moments (ceremony kiss, first dance, speeches, cake cutting, more).
- Syncs audio and video from multiple sources, cleans up sound, and applies consistent color grading.
- Offers multiple export formats for sharing on Vimeo, YouTube, Instagram, and other platforms.
- Supports creation of same-day edits, standalone speech/toast clips, and long-form cinematic edits.
